research.title: React State Management in 2026: A Decision Tree, Not a Religion
research.whyTrending: The community finally converged on a clean split — server state (TanStack Query, always), server-owned state (RSC + Server Actions), and a small remainder of client-only UI state (Zustand ~3KB). Redux dropped from 57% to 38% among React Native devs between 2023 and 2026 while Zustand nearly tripled. Real numbers exist: 1000 subscribing components render in 12ms (Zustand), 14ms (Jotai), 18ms (Redux Toolkit), 3ms (signals). This is one of the highest-volume evergreen React queries and the blog has literally zero coverage of it.
research.gapNote: Biggest evergreen hole in 176 posts. Pairs with existing tanstack-query and RSC posts for internal linking.
